review_sessions.advisory_summary: The four machine-readable contracts support a design-only PASS when every operational prerequisite and Human Decision remains explicitly blocked.
The protocol schemas are complete enough for a bounded design PASS, while unassigned instances, empty logs, zero counts and undecided gates remain execution blockers.
The contracts are useful templates, but concrete assignments and populated parameters should precede any claim of complete design.

shared_execution_blockers: No independent Reviewer instance is assigned.
No blind custodian, blind key, origin mapping or unblinding record exists.
No experiment Provider profile is adopted and no experiment data is processed.
MODEL_COUNT, SESSION_COUNT, ROLE_COUNT and INDEPENDENT_LINEAGE_COUNT are all zero.

dissent_preserved: DeepSeek did not recommend design-only PASS without concrete control assignments.
Qwen and Kimi recommended PASS only when its scope is exactly PROTOCOL_DESIGN_COMPLETENESS_ONLY.
All three sessions rejected experiment execution.
known_limitations: Advisory review is not Human Decision, independent experimental lineage or empirical fairness evidence.
Provider and model diversity in advisory review does not instantiate experiment participants.
The DeepSeek dissent remains part of the auditable review record.
